frozen.model: BAAI/bge-m3 (dense memory projection only; no LLM participates in any AOEP machine criterion)
frozen.policy: 015.memory_policy.1: builtin generic DomainProfile defaults; no consolidation_enabled, no promotion, no lifecycle grant
frozen.prompt: none - no prompt, distiller or model call is part of any AOEP case
frozen.recall: 015.aoep.recall.1: consumption surfaces are recall(scope_ref=[...]) plus the live manifest/inspect() report; per-projection denominators are read from the live reducer state of the current manifest
frozen.snapshot: 015.eval.1 cases array (sha256 of the canonical cases array; pinned in snapshot_hash, recomputable with tests.memory_eval_datasets.frozen_subset_hash)
frozen.vocabulary: 015.aoep.vocabulary.1: projections relation/dense/links/summary/file (+ field projection salience, excluded from deletion propagation); error codes MISSING_KNOWLEDGE_SCOPE/AMBIGUOUS_DOMAIN_REF/MEMORY_ROLLBACK_FORBIDDEN/MEMORY_WRITE_UNAVAILABLE/MEMORY_EVIDENCE_ANCHOR_REQUIRED; authority event types assert/revise/access/retract/rollback

traceable_rollback.statement: 回滚可溯：回滚事件存在且 request_id 与治理响应一致、事件链闭合（回放 id 序列与权威日志逐项相等、无缺失、无重复——event_id 为 snowflake，MUST NOT 实现为数值连续性）、水位可读、全状态与逐投影指纹一致、影响面计数一致、可再次回滚到相邻检查点、access 事件保留

deletion_propagation.statement: 删除传播：retire 与 purge 两形态后对关系/向量/链接/摘要/文件五类投影各自独立断言『该条可消费命中数 = 0』且各自分母非零；权威日志保留 retract 事件与来源链（content_text/content_hash 仍在）；salience 为字段投影，不参与本断言

authority_monotonicity.statement: 权威单调：越权写入（声明超出写入者权威 / 非写实例 / 只读实例）与经 MCP 面改写绑定表的尝试全部被拒（403 或结构化错误）；拒绝前后权威日志 id 序列逐项相等、authority 轴取值不变、绑定表行集不变，且每次拒绝均可在响应错误码或权威日志中观测到

provenance_preservation.statement: 来源保全：retire/purge/rollback 状态转移后 provenance 元数据与来源链保留，content_hash 可复算且重算值与记录值逐项相等（不得仅『字段存在』），权威日志保留墓碑/retract 事件与来源链且历史未被物理回删，受影响投影经 projection_fingerprint 复算一致

scope_non_expansion.statement: 范围不扩张：歧义引用与缺失/空（空串与只含空白）scope 引用一律被拒并给出候选域（AMBIGUOUS_DOMAIN_REF / MISSING_KNOWLEDGE_SCOPE），『回落最近域/全库』成功次数 = 0，拒绝留审计；缺失≠歧义，两类各自构造用例、各自给出非零样本量、分别记分

_meta.review_notes: R6.1 with an event-point target and the re-rollback requirement. Machine program: the authority log holds an event with event_type=rollback whose request_id equals the governance response request_id; the event chain is closed as replay(scope) ids == authority ids item by item, no missing and no duplicate (explicitly NOT numeric continuity - event_id is a sparse snowflake); the rollback event payload event_point is consistent with memory_projection_meta.source_event_id before and after; before/after_fingerprint equal the independently recomputed projection_fingerprint(reduce_events(replay)); every per-view fingerprint equals the MemoryProjectionMeta.fingerprint written at projection_fingerprint(state[view]); inspect() reports matches_replay for all six views; impact.memory_ids equals the entries diff; a second rollback to an adjacent checkpoint is self-consistent; access events are retained.

_meta.review_notes: R6.1 with a time-point target: the target is the ISO occurred_at of the first assert, and RollbackService folds it to the last event with occurred_at <= time_point; every other sub-condition of R6.1 is measured identically to the event-point case, plus the re-rollback to an adjacent checkpoint.

Negative control for the R6.1 checker (quickstart.md VS-04 反例): a real MemoryManagementAudit row written by an actual management rebuild supplies a queryable request_id while the authority log holds no event carrying that request_id and no rollback event at all. The R6.1 checker MUST judge that audit-only reference failed; this case is passed only when the checker returns failed, i.e. the checker cannot be satisfied by an audit record alone.

_meta.review_notes: R6.2 via purge (event_type=retract with payload.purge=true). Identical five-projection scoring and non-zero denominator construction as the retire case; the purge marker must be observable in the tombstone event.

R6.5 case construction from R6.3: a raw event append (apply_event), an untrusted management command (actor=mcp), an untrusted binding grant, the MCP surface tools rollback/grant/scope_bindings, an MCP record_memory call with forbidden extra arguments (extra=forbid) and an MCP record_memory call that declares hard/management authority without anchors must all be rejected. Measured invariants: the authority log id sequence before == after item by item, the authority axis value per entry is unchanged, the scope_bindings row set is unchanged, and every rejection is observable as a 403/structured error code.

_meta.review_notes: R6.5 + T026: a non-management rollback is actually ATTEMPTED along three separate routes - (i) the MCP surface (the MCP tool set exposes only record_memory/recall_memory/start_work, so a rollback tool call is refused), (ii) a non-writer instance (service-level rollback with an untrusted actor and an MCP record_memory call while no writer lease is held), and (iii) a read-only instance (REST POST /api/memories/rollback with no writer lease, and with instance_mode=reader). All three must be rejected, the authority log id sequence before == after item by item, and the attempt sample size (attempted) and success count (succeeded) must be reported; attempted == 0 MUST be recorded not_measurable, never as met.

_meta.review_notes: R6.6 across all three state transitions (rollback tombstone, retire, purge) inside one isolated scope: content_text, content_hash, provenance, confidence, inference_meta, evidence_refs, provenance_validation, kind, source_event_id and all six governance axes are preserved verbatim for every affected identity, and content_hash is RECOMPUTED item by item over every assert/revise event payload (sha256(content_text) == content_hash) instead of only checking field presence.

R6.6 authority-log side: after retire + purge + rollback the log still holds the original assert event, the revise event with its supersedes_memory_id source chain and both retract tombstones (with the purge marker), the physical event count only grows (history is never deleted), and the affected projections recompute consistently - projection_fingerprint(reduce_events(replay(scope))) equals the manifest fingerprint and inspect() reports matches_replay for all six views.

R6.4 ambiguous family: two active project scopes share one name, so the type:name reference resolves to a candidate list. Every surface (MemoryScopeResolver.resolve, MCP record_memory, MCP recall_memory, REST GET /api/memories) must reject with AMBIGUOUS_DOMAIN_REF and a non-empty candidates list; the successful 'nearest domain / whole library' fallback count must be 0; a non-zero sample size is reported for this case separately from the missing/empty family.

R6.4/FR-061 missing family (the argument is absent, not ambiguous): the service-level write (record without scope_id), the read path (resolve_many([]) and resolve_many(None)), the MCP surfaces (record_memory/recall_memory without scope_ref) and REST GET /api/memories without scope_ref must all be rejected with MISSING_KNOWLEDGE_SCOPE (REST request-level: 422) and the rejection must carry candidate domains; the fallback success count must be 0. Scored separately from the empty-string and whitespace-only cases.
